title: Tempo Endurance Run with Lower Body Strength

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Smooth spinal flexion and extension. Move deliberately to warm up the core and prepare for dynamic movement.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Controlled hip mobility work. Keep chest up and alternate sides smoothly to prepare hips for running.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each stretch for 20-30 seconds per leg. Focus on calf flexibility for running efficiency.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.cues: Light and bouncy. Increase heart rate gradually while activating hamstrings and hip flexors.

items.name: Tempo Run
items.cues: Sustained effort at RPE 7-8. Maintain steady pace that feels challenging but sustainable. Focus on rhythm and breathing. This is race-specific preparation for the 90km Vasaloppet.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Controlled descent, explosive ascent. Drive through heels. Build lower body power for mountain sections of Vasaloppet.

items.name: Box Step-Down
items.cues: Controlled eccentric loading. Step down slowly with one leg extended. Builds quad endurance for downhill running.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold 30 seconds per leg. Release tension from running effort.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Gentle hip adductor stretch. Slow, controlled movements to reduce post-workout tension.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Controlled core stability work. Move slowly and deliberately to engage stabilizers without fatigue.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Gentle spinal mobilization. Relax and breathe deeply to restore baseline.

rationale: Tempo workout at RPE 7-8 directly supports Vasaloppet 90km race preparation by building sustainable high-intensity aerobic capacity within 53 days to event.
Strategically avoided upper body pressing to respect current mild shoulder soreness (3/5 severity), focusing instead on lower body strength and running-specific endurance.
Integrated eccentric loading (squats, step-downs) to build quad and posterior chain durability for the challenging mountain terrain of the Vasaloppet course.
